title: The difference between ‘Free Speech’ and free speech
gist: Green argues politicians, led by Trump, increasingly invoke 'free speech' and 'national security' as slogans detached from principle, illustrated by Trump banning CNN and others from the White House as a 'national security' threat; UK politics shows similar cynical use of 'legitimate concerns'. He warns of an eventual credibility crunch when genuine security threats are not taken seriously.

insights.claim: Trump justified banning news outlets from the White House by claiming to cherish a free press while attacking 'FAKE NEWS' as a 'threat to our National Security'.
